narr: Intense and back-building thunderstorms led to severe weather and flash flooding across portions of the area.
ev: Significant roadway and property flooding at Saint John Rd. and Old Saw Mill Rd.
Horry County Fire Rescue reported a vehicle trapped in floodwater along Pee Dee Rd. South between Frye Rd. and Chinners Creek Rd. No reported injuries.
